name: skynet
description: Optimize your code against your own metric with Skynet, and manage the runs.

interface.longDescription:
Skynet improves the code in a GitHub repository against a metric that you write. You give the repository, the paths the run may change, a Python score function and, when the metric needs them, a few test cases. Skynet runs optimization engines such as GEPA in a sandbox, scores each new version, and returns the best version as a change to your starting commit, with its score next to the starting score.

With this plugin, your assistant sets up a run step by step, checks its price, suggests a spending limit, starts the run only after you agree to the limit, follows its progress, and shows the result. It can also list your runs and stop a run. A run spends at most the limit you set from your existing Skynet balance. Unused budget is released when the run ends. You need a Skynet account at skynetml.com.
capabilities: Set up a repository run and suggest a spending limit
Start an optimization run with a limit you approve
Follow a run and show its result
defaultPrompt: Optimize the code in my GitHub repository with Skynet against my test cases.
What is the status of my last Skynet run?

positive.description: Check a repository run before it runs
positive.prompt: Set up a Skynet run on my repository acme/support-bot and tell me what limit to set: improve the ticket classifier in classifier/, with 6 labeled cases and an exact-match metric.
positive.tools_triggered: repo_draft_start, repo_draft_set_repository, repo_draft_set_data, repo_draft_set_scorer, repo_draft_set_models, repo_draft_set_engine, repo_draft_review
positive.expected_behavior: Builds the draft one step at a time and fixes the issues each step reports. Calls repo_draft_review and reports the minimum and suggested max_cost_cents and the spendable balance. Does not call repo_draft_submit.

positive.description: Start a run after the user agrees to a limit
positive.prompt: Optimize the ticket classifier in my repository acme/support-bot with Skynet. I agree to a limit of 5 dollars.
positive.expected_behavior: Builds and reviews the draft first, then calls repo_draft_submit with max_cost_cents 500 and confirm true. Returns the optimization_id and the run status.

positive.description: Follow a run and show its result
positive.prompt: How is my last Skynet run doing? Show the result if it is done.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the newest run with list_runs, calls get_run, and reports the status and spend. For a finished run, shows the baseline score, the best score and the best version.

positive.prompt: List my Skynet runs that failed.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_runs with status failed and lists each run's name, status and creation time.

positive.description: Stop a run the user names
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the running run with list_runs, confirms which run to stop, then calls stop_run and reports that spend stopped.

negative.prompt: Add 50 dollars of credit to my Skynet account.
What is the weather in Paris tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or credits and does not process payments. A run spends at most a limit the user approves from the balance of an existing Skynet account.
